content: Create an corner with two 140x140 plates at a 90° angle to each other. The first plate has in its center a cutout of 45x45. All plates are 10mm thick | Now i want you to execute the prepared function calls one after the other. If you need to do some calculations or geometrical algebra, use the CreateCode Function first. Execute the first prepared function call. Submit all required variables at once

{"PythonCode":"import math

# Dimensions of the plates
plate_size = 140
plate_thickness = 10
cutout_size = 45

# Calculate the position of the first plate (centered at origin)
first_plate_x = plate_size / 2
first_plate_y = plate_size / 2
first_plate_z = plate_thickness / 2

# Calculate the position of the second plate (rotated 90 degrees around the z-axis)
second_plate_x = plate_size / 2
second_plate_y = plate_size / 2
second_plate_z = plate_thickness / 2 + plate_size

# Calculate the position of the cutout (centered on the first plate)
cutout_x = first_plate_x
cutout_y = first_plate_y
cutout_z = first_plate_z

# Output the calculated positions
print(f"First plate position: x={first_plate_x}, y={first_plate_y}, z={first_plate_z}")
print(f"Second plate position: x={second_plate_x}, y={second_plate_y}, z={second_plate_z}")
print(f"Cutout position: x={cutout_x}, y={cutout_y}, z={cutout_z}")"}
